name: San Francisco
summary: The city for which the narrator of The Call of Cthulhu took a train while following the Alert's trail, and the city in whose hospital the narrator of Dagon awoke after being rescued from the Pacific.
description:
After a day of hurried cabling and arranging, the narrator bade his host adieu and took a train for San Francisco.

In Dagon, the narrator awoke in a San Francisco hospital after his ordeal at sea, having been brought there by the captain of the American ship that had picked up his boat in mid-ocean.

sources.quote: That evening, after a day of hurried cabling and arranging, I bade my host adieu and took a train for San Francisco.
sources.context: Chapter 3, The Madness from the Sea

sources.quote: When I came out of the shadows I was in a San Francisco hospital; brought thither by the captain of the American ship which had picked up my boat in mid-ocean.
